diff --git a/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go b/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go
index 3127f78..c9cc87f 100644
--- a/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go
+++ b/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go
@@ -40,4 +40,31 @@ var _ = Describe("HashFunc", func() {
 		Expect(sum).To(Equal(hashFunc("1", input)))
 		Expect(sum2).To(Equal(hashFunc("2", input)))
 	})
+
+	It("restores a prior seed after reseeding", func() {
+		h := hasher.NewHasher()
+		hashFunc := h.HashFunc()
+		h.SetSeed("id", "original")
+		original := hashFunc("id", input)
+		Expect(hashFunc("id", input)).To(Equal(original))
+
+		h.Reseed("id")
+		Expect(hashFunc("id", input)).NotTo(Equal(original))
+
+		h.SetSeed("id", "original")
+		Expect(hashFunc("id", input)).To(Equal(original))
+		other := hasher.NewHasher()
+		other.SetSeed("id", "original")
+		Expect(other.HashFunc()("id", input)).To(Equal(original))
+	})
+
+	It("uses the global SetSeed for existing hash functions", func() {
+		hashFunc := hasher.HashFunc()
+		hasher.SetSeed("global-test-id", "first")
+		first := hashFunc("global-test-id", input)
+		hasher.SetSeed("global-test-id", "second")
+		Expect(hashFunc("global-test-id", input)).NotTo(Equal(first))
+		hasher.SetSeed("global-test-id", "first")
+		Expect(hashFunc("global-test-id", input)).To(Equal(first))
+	})
 })
